title: WWC27-MedAgent: a living paper agent for sports medicine and science preparation for the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that turns the Current Opinion 'Sports Medicine and Science Considerations to Maximise Preparation for the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027: From Static Evidence to a Living Agent' (submitted to Sports Medicine) into validated tools, machine-readable resources and prompts. The release includes the curated evidence table, host-city data, a screening and monitoring matrix, air-quality and airway-health data, adapters and a scheduled puller for live air-quality sources, automated tests and a 61-item validation benchmark. Decision support only; not a substitute for clinical judgement.
